user_prompt: In adults with overweight or obesity, what is the effect of a smartphone app intervention compared with no intervention or a minimal, non-app intervention (such as printed materials, a food diary, or usual care), on body weight in kilograms at short-term follow-up (3 to <6 months, preferably 3–4 months)? The comparator arm must be genuine no/minimal intervention — NOT another smartphone app or a different version of the same app; exclude any study where both arms receive a smartphone app. Use one endpoint per study; when a study reports both a follow-up value and a change-from-baseline value for the same outcome, prefer the change-from-baseline value. Do not extract, classify, or pool physical activity, BMI, self-efficacy, dietary behaviour, quality of life, or any other outcome, and exclude medium-term (6 months) or long-term (≥12 months) assessments.
